declarations.signature: structure CellData where
def rowCheck (P Q v capA capC T : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (bounds : BoundsDatum) : Bool
def shifts : List ℤ
def shiftCheck (P Q capA capC T : ℕ) (ds : List ℤ) (data : CellData) : Bool
def cellCheck (P Q capA capC T : ℕ) (data : CellData) : Bool

theorem rowCheck_sound {P Q v capA capC T A C n : ℕ} {d : ℤ} {bounds : BoundsDatum}
    (hcheck : rowCheck P Q v capA capC T d bounds = true)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hAcap : A ≤ capA) (hCcap : C ≤ capC)
    (heq : (P : ℤ) * (A : ℤ) - (Q : ℤ) * (C : ℤ) = d)
    (hn : n ≤ min (P * A) (Q * C) + 10) : n ≤ T
theorem mem_shifts {d : ℤ} (hlo : -10 ≤ d) (hhi : d ≤ 10) : d ∈ shifts

theorem shiftCheck_append {P Q capA capC T : ℕ} {left right : List ℤ} {data : CellData}
    (hl : shiftCheck P Q capA capC T left data = true)
    (hr : shiftCheck P Q capA capC T right data = true) :
    shiftCheck P Q capA capC T (left ++ right) data = true

theorem cellCheck_sound {P Q capA capC T A C n : ℕ} {d : ℤ} {data : CellData}
    (hcheck : cellCheck P Q capA capC T data = true)
    (hdlo : -10 ≤ d) (hdhi : d ≤ 10)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hAcap : A ≤ capA) (hCcap : C ≤ capC)
    (heq : (P : ℤ) * (A : ℤ) - (Q : ℤ) * (C : ℤ) = d)
    (hn : n ≤ min (P * A) (Q * C) + 10) : n ≤ T
def heightCap (H M P : ℕ) : ℕ

theorem height_cap_of_product_le {A P n H M : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P)
    (hproduct : A * P ≤ n) (hnH : n < H) (hM : A ≤ M) : A ≤ heightCap H M P

theorem height_cap_of_window {A P n a H M : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P)
    (hM : A ≤ M) (hnH : n < H) (heq : n - a = P * A) : A ≤ heightCap H M P

theorem power_lt_height_of_window {A P n a H : ℕ} (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hnH : n < H) (heq : n - a = P * A) : P < H

theorem actual_window_height_cap {n p H M : ℕ} (window : PrimeWindow n p)
    (hp : p.Prime) (hnH : n < H) (hM : window.cofactor ≤ M) :
    window.cofactor ≤ heightCap H M (primeComponent n p)

theorem integer_window_links {n a b : ℕ} (ha : a < 11) (hb : b < 11) :
    -(10 : ℤ) ≤ ((n - a : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((n - b : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
    ((n - a : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((n - b : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ 10 ∧
    n ≤ min (n - a) (n - b) + 10

def blockCheck (p q H M T aStart aCount bStart bCount : ℕ)
    (data : ℕ → ℕ → CellData) : Bool
def rectangleCheck (p q H M T amax bmax : ℕ) (data : ℕ → ℕ → CellData) : Bool

theorem rectangleCheck_sound {p q H M T amax bmax a b A C n : ℕ} {d : ℤ}
    {data : ℕ → ℕ → CellData}
    (hcheck : rectangleCheck p q H M T amax bmax data = true)
    (ha0 : 1 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ amax) (hb0 : 1 ≤ b) (hb1 : b ≤ bmax)
    (hdlo : -10 ≤ d) (hdhi : d ≤ 10) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hAcap : A ≤ heightCap H M (p ^ a)) (hCcap : C ≤ heightCap H M (q ^ b))
    (heq : ((p ^ a : ℕ) : ℤ) * (A : ℤ) - ((q ^ b : ℕ) : ℤ) * (C : ℤ) = d)
    (hn : n ≤ min (p ^ a * A) (q ^ b * C) + 10) : n ≤ T

theorem exponent_le_of_pow_lt {p a amax H : ℕ} (hp : 1 < p)
    (hcut : H ≤ p ^ (amax + 1)) (hsmall : p ^ a < H) : a ≤ amax

theorem grid_windows_sound {p q H M T amax bmax a b A C n r s : ℕ}
    {data : ℕ → ℕ → CellData}
    (hcheck : rectangleCheck p q H M T amax bmax data = true)
    (hp : 1 < p) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hcutP : H ≤ p ^ (amax + 1)) (hcutQ : H ≤ q ^ (bmax + 1))
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hnH : n < H)
    (hr : r < 11) (hs : s < 11) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hAM : A ≤ M) (hCM : C ≤ M)
    (hP : n - r = p ^ a * A) (hQ : n - s = q ^ b * C) : n ≤ T

theorem grid_windows_sound_swapped {p q H M T amax bmax a b A C n r s : ℕ}
    {data : ℕ → ℕ → CellData}
    (hcheck : rectangleCheck p q H M T amax bmax data = true)
    (hp : 1 < p) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hcutP : H ≤ p ^ (amax + 1)) (hcutQ : H ≤ q ^ (bmax + 1))
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hnH : n < H)
    (hr : r < 11) (hs : s < 11) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hAM : A ≤ M) (hCM : C ≤ M)
    (hP : n - r = q ^ b * A) (hQ : n - s = p ^ a * C) : n ≤ T

theorem actual_i11_bounded_cofactor_bridge {n j H M : ℕ}
    (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hlarge : 110 ≤ n) (hMn : M < n) (hnH : n < H)
    (hij : 11 < j) (hjn : j ≤ n / 2)
    (hcertificate : (2 * Nat.factorial 11) ^ 11 * H ^ 7 ≤ i11K * M ^ 33)
    (hno : ¬ Common n 11 j) :
    ∃ p q h k a b A C : ℕ,
      p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ p ∈ ({2, 3, 5, 7} : Finset ℕ) ∧
      q ∈ ({2, 3, 5, 7} : Finset ℕ) ∧ p ≠ q ∧
      h = (n.choose 11).factorization p ∧ k = (n.choose 11).factorization q ∧
      0 < h ∧ 0 < k ∧ a < 11 ∧ b < 11 ∧ 1 ≤ A ∧ 1 ≤ C ∧ A ≤ M ∧ C ≤ M ∧
      n - a = p ^ h * A ∧ n - b = q ^ k * C ∧ Nat.dist (n - a) (n - b) ≤ 10

theorem distinct_pair_below_109 (data : SixPairRows)
    (check23 : pairCheck 2 3 10 45 15359 68 ((2 : ℕ) ^ 15360) data.rows23 = true)
    (check25 : pairCheck 2 5 10 44 15359 66 ((2 : ℕ) ^ 15360) data.rows25 = true)
    (check27 : pairCheck 2 7 10 43 15359 65 ((2 : ℕ) ^ 15360) data.rows27 = true)
    (check35 : pairCheck 3 5 10 32 9691 75 ((2 : ℕ) ^ 15360) data.rows35 = true)
    (check37 : pairCheck 3 7 10 32 9691 75 ((2 : ℕ) ^ 15360) data.rows37 = true)
    (check57 : pairCheck 5 7 10 32 6615 109 ((2 : ℕ) ^ 15360) data.rows57 = true)
    {p q n r s h k A C : ℕ}
    (hpMem : p ∈ ({2, 3, 5, 7} : Finset ℕ))
    (hqMem : q ∈ ({2, 3, 5, 7} : Finset ℕ)) (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hnH : n < (2 : ℕ) ^ 15360) (hr : r ≤ 10) (hs : s ≤ 10)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hP : n - r = p ^ h * A) (hQ : n - s = q ^ k * C)
    (hsmallA : A ^ 3 ≤ min (n - r) (n - s))
    (hsmallC : C ^ 3 ≤ min (n - r) (n - s)) : n < (2 : ℕ) ^ 109
def allPairRows : SixPairRows where
def i11K : ℕ
theorem i11_smallPrimeCount : smallPrimeCount 11 = 4

theorem i11_noCommon_small_part_lower_of_upper_certificate
    {n j H M : ℕ}
    (hij : 11 < j) (hjn : j ≤ n / 2)
    (hlarge : 110 ≤ n) (hnH : n ≤ H)
    (hcertificate : (2 * Nat.factorial 11) ^ 11 * H ^ 7 ≤ i11K * M ^ 33)
    (hno : ¬ Common n 11 j) :
    n ^ 4 ≤ M ^ 3 * smallPrimePart n 11
